goal: Provide a controlled Obsidian vault automation boundary that can safely expose read-only vault operations before any write-back, obsidian-cli, or ingestion pipeline is allowed to touch a local vault.

acceptance_criteria.description: Vault access is restricted to configured vault roots only; absolute paths, traversal, and symlinks that resolve outside the vault are rejected before file IO.
The Phase 1 wrapper is read-only and exposes list directory, read note, literal search, frontmatter parsing, and backlink reads without invoking shell commands or obsidian-cli.
Write requests default to denied; dry-run write planning records an audit log, never mutates files, and requires configured allowlisted write paths before future execution can be enabled.
The contract keeps obsidian-cli behind the controlled wrapper, keeps defuddle-style capture and cleaning in an isolated queue, and separates authoring skills from execution skills.
The Phase 1 scope documents the later sync surfaces for company knowledge maps, RawRefs, and review workbench notes while explicitly excluding live write-back and bulk delete or move operations.
The NAS main Agent can search, read, and list the real mounted company Obsidian vault through bounded admin-only LLM tools while the container mount remains read-only.

permission_model.vault_roots: Configured paths only; callers pass vault-relative paths to the wrapper.
permission_model.write_policy: Writes require an allowlisted vault-relative prefix, dry-run planning, audit logging, and later explicit approval before execution.
forbidden_operations: moving vault files outside configured vault roots
permission_model.audit: All write planning and denied write attempts must append JSONL audit records with actor, action, target_path, dry_run, allowed, result, and timestamp.

agent_skill_boundaries.obsidian_cli: May be enabled only through the controlled wrapper; skills must not execute obsidian-cli directly.
agent_skill_boundaries.capture_cleaning: defuddle-style capture and cleaning goes to an isolated staging queue and cannot write the vault directly.

skill_types.authoring_skill: May propose note content or metadata.
skill_types.execution_skill: May request wrapper operations and must receive policy decisions, dry-run plans, and audit ids.

non_goals: Do not enable live write-back in Phase 1.
Do not invoke obsidian-cli directly from agent skills.
Do not allow arbitrary shell commands.
Do not support bulk delete or bulk move operations.
Do not let capture or cleaning queues write directly to the vault.
Do not move files outside configured vault roots.
